After 76 days of Democrat obstruction, funding for DHS has finally been sent to President Trump’s desk for his signature. Thank you to Secret Service, TSA, Coast Guard, FEMA, and CISA personnel for your service while Democrats played politics with your livelihoods and America’s national security.

ICE and CBP next!

Thank you to the dedicated healthcare workers across the state, as well as the @CDCgov and @HHSGov, for their coordinated efforts to bring the measles outbreak in South Carolina to an end.

I also appreciate @SecKennedy's support for my PREDICT Act, which strengthens wastewater surveillance to detect outbreaks – including measles - earlier and proactively protect our communities.

Lauren is working as a nursing support apprentice with Prisma Health. Her grandpa’s experiences with the nurses who cared for him inspired her to do the same and give back to her community. We can’t wait to see all the lives you positively impact, Lauren! #NationalApprenticeshipWeek

Video

During National Apprenticeship Week, we celebrate the power of apprenticeships in providing both classroom learning and hands-on experience that help individuals grow in their chosen field.

Apprentices have the unique opportunity to be students while earning pay at the same time, gaining real-world skills with an income.

These programs open doors to meaningful careers while strengthening the future workforce!
